lead: What the crypto market is doing right now, plus the red flags most trading sites leave out. Mevrouw Mintje checks every trending Solana token for you.
warn: Facts, not signals. Trending means many people trade it now, not that it will go up. Most new tokens lose almost everything. No flags does not mean safe. Not financial advice.
pT: The 20 pools people trade most right now, each with automatic red flags from public data.
pN: Solana pools created in the last hours. This is where most rug pulls start: look before you touch.
pM: The 20 biggest coins by market value, with their last 7 days.
fN: A daily mood score for crypto from 0 (extreme fear) to 100 (extreme greed). Mood, not a forecast.
pD: Total value locked: how much money sits in apps on each blockchain.
q1: What do the red flags mean?
a1: They are automatic checks on public pool data: very thin liquidity, a pool younger than a day, buys without any sells, trading volume far above the liquidity, and huge 24-hour price jumps or crashes. A token without flags is not safe; it only passed these few checks. Open the full Token Checkup for mint and freeze authority, holders and the creator wallet.
a2: No. Trending means many people trade it right now, not that it will go up. Most new tokens lose almost all their value. The radar shows public facts and risks only. Not financial advice.
q3: Where does the data come from?
a3: Your browser loads it directly from public free sources: GeckoTerminal (Solana pools), CoinGecko (top coins), alternative.me (Fear and Greed index) and DefiLlama (DeFi value locked). No account and no wallet are needed. Data can be late or wrong.
fSrc: Data: GeckoTerminal, CoinGecko, alternative.me, DefiLlama. Not financial advice.
